body:
First off a little background. About 4-5 years ago (I forget when 4-mmc was big) I had a serious m cat problem it very nearly cost me my life. So naturally I have been avoiding prolonged use of any stimulant favouring psychedelics as its basically impossible to become addicted. I have tried one or two since then (NRG, MDPV, B2) but none of them have been very good.
About a year ago a good friend of mine called me to tell me about this substance he had been reading about and that he had placed an order for 5 grams of fine powder ethylphenidate. When the parcel arrived we did the usual 5-10mg allergy test and decided we would try it out properly the next night.
What ensued over the next week was an absolute frenzy of EPH and heaps of cannabis. And from what I remember I had a really good time (in retrospect 5 grams is too much for two people.
in retrospect 5 grams is too much for two people.
)
I have experimented with this chemical a couple of times since then with crowds of my friends and in clubs with random strangers but the reason for this experiment is to experience it alone.
First dose taken at around 2230.
Roughly 20-25mg insufflated + 20-15mg ingested (dissolved in shot of water.)
Obvious rush about 5 minutes after insufflation. Unable to sit still. I have a beard so licking the long bits on the end of my moustache eliminates need to chew the inside of my mouth. No real need for music as I am enjoying the music inside my head. About 15-20 minutes in and the bomb I took has started kicking in. Usual slow tingling sensation in my legs. I could do with finding something to do but typing this is keeping me well occupied.
2nd dose taken around 2330
Slightly bigger line about 35mg
This EPH burns a lot. I bought it from a well known vendor in a 3g bag of large crystal. Most of which got consumed over the weekend and I have noticed I either have built up a tolerance or it just isn't hitting as hard because I am more used to it. My concentration has increased dramatically. Rubiks cube time down by about 30 seconds. I think it's due to my brain working too fast for my hands a pretty common side effect from stimulants.
The same is happening to my mouth when I try to beatbox. A new sensation to me as I haven't been doing it that long. Juggling is as always a resounding success. But that's pretty much second nature to me.
3rd dose taken at about 0230.
Slightly bigger again. At approximately 40-45mg.
(I don't have scales and don't want to push it.)
This shit is just getting worse and worse on the nose. It's made smoking surprisingly unpleasant. Which is unusual. I am avoiding cannabis this time as it made me almost brain dead the last time and I had to re-dose a lot to get back up to standard.
Over all EPH is a very good chemical. Not nearly as good as 4-mmc. But I can see EPH being less addictive because it's 3am and I am calling it a night with some t.v and a handful of etiz when I reach baseline (ish) .
Too much too fast is not enjoyable.
I hope this helps anyone looking to get back into sticks, or thinking about taking it alone.
Have fun and stay safe. \m/
